changes.old: On 17 June 2026, Kegstar made a remedy offer to the ACCC in the form of an undertaking pursuant to s87B of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth), which places obligations on Kegstar to n On 17 June 2026, Kegstar made a remedy offer to the ACCC in the form of an undertaking pursuant to s87B of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth), which places obligations on Kegstar to not enforce exclusivity provisions for a period of time, offer existing Konvoy customers Kegstar contracts on specified terms if requested, provide customers the option to purchase kegs in certain circumstances, and incorporate key performance indicators into all Customer Contracts (the remedy offer). Submissions or comments about this remedy offer should be provided by 5:00pm AEST on 1 July 2026 via email to mergers@accc.gov.au with a copy to mergersru@accc.gov.au with the title submission re: Microstar – Konvoy – Remedy offer. read more 24 Jun 2026 Microstar Konvoy - Remedy offer Attachment 487.19 KB 24 Jun 2026 Microstar Konvoy - Questionnaire - Remedy offer Attachment 119.5 KB
